name: Twisted bow
description: Accuracy and max hit scale up with the target's Magic level, up to +140% accuracy and +250% damage vs. very high Magic targets; reduced vs. low-Magic targets.

name: Dragon hunter lance
description: +20% accuracy and +25% damage against Draconic-type monsters when wielded.

name: Dragon hunter crossbow
description: +25% accuracy and +30% damage against Draconic-type monsters.

name: Craw's bow
description: +50% accuracy and damage while inside the Wilderness, decaying over time unless recharged with Wilderness Sword/Bow/Wand shards.

name: Tumeken's shadow
description: Triples the base Magic damage bonus of most staves/wands (quadruples it in the Ancient Guild) and multiplies spell damage roughly 3x outside of raids.

name: Scythe of vitur
description: Hits up to 3 targets in a line at once: 100% damage to the first, 50% to the second, 25% to the third.

name: Voidwaker
description: Special attack hits twice with a guaranteed minimum-damage hit plus a bonus damage roll based on the target's current HP.

name: Inquisitor's mace
description: Crush accuracy and damage boosted further per piece of Inquisitor's armour worn, up to +1% per piece on top of normal set bonuses.

name: Keris partisan
description: Chance to deal triple damage against Kalphite-type monsters (including the Kalphite Queen).

name: Blade of saeldor
description: Damage scales with target's defence: deals bonus damage against lower-defence targets compared to a raw stat comparison would suggest.

name: Osmumten's fang
description: With stab attacks, re-rolls a failed accuracy check once; on any successful hit, damage is always rolled between 15% and 85% of max hit instead of the usual 0-100%, making it far more consistent (though not higher DPS) than raw stats suggest.

name: Venator bow
description: When charged with ancient essence, attacks in multi-combat areas can ricochet to up to 2 additional nearby targets, each rolling accuracy independently and dealing up to 2/3 of the original max hit.

name: Webweaver bow
description: +50% Ranged accuracy and damage against any NPC while in the Wilderness (identical mechanic to Craw's bow, on an upgraded base weapon); requires revenant ether as ammo.

name: Sanguinesti staff
description: 1 in 5 chance on a successful hit with its built-in spell to deal 8 additional damage and heal the wielder for half the total damage dealt.

name: Dinh's bulwark
description: Two combat-style-dependent passives: Block style prevents attacking but reduces all incoming damage by 20% (extra vs. Crush, none in PvP), with an 8-tick delay after switching; Pummel style lets you attack and grants a strength bonus that scales with your average Defence bonus (kicks in above 314).

name: Elysian spirit shield
description: 70% chance to reduce incoming damage by 25% on any hit, excluding dragonfire and poison damage.

name: Arclight
description: +70% accuracy and +70% damage against demons, while also counting as a silver weapon for relevant monster interactions.

name: Emberlight
description: +70% accuracy and +70% damage against demons; like Arclight, but permanent and without charge degradation.

name: Granite hammer
description: +30% Golembane effect, dealing +30% extra damage and accuracy against all golem-type creatures.

name: Abyssal bludgeon
description: Special attack 'Penance' deals +0.5% extra damage for every prayer point the wielder is currently missing relative to max, at the cost of 50% special attack energy.

name: Dragon claws
description: Special attack 'Slice and Dice' rolls accuracy on each of 4 hits independently, but once any hit lands, every remaining hit in the sequence is guaranteed to succeed.

name: Dragon warhammer
description: Special attack 'Smash' reduces the target's current Defence by 30% on a hit, stacking multiplicatively with each further use. Against Tekton, the first special attack is guaranteed to hit, and even a miss still reduces Defence by 5%.

name: Elder maul
description: Special attack 'Pulverize' reduces the target's current Defence by 35% and boosts accuracy by 25%, stronger than the dragon warhammer's equivalent. It has a 1-tick animation delay compared to a normal attack, and also guarantees a first hit vs. Tekton.

name: Bandos godsword
description: Special attack 'Warstrike' always rolls accuracy against the target's slash defence regardless of the combat style selected, and drains stats in a fixed order (Defence, Strength, Prayer, Attack, Magic, Ranged), only moving to the next stat once the current one reaches 0.

name: Saradomin godsword
description: Special attack 'Healing Blade' heals 50% and restores 25% prayer of the damage dealt (minimum 10 HP / 5 prayer on a successful hit), calculated from pre-mitigation damage - so it can still heal even against targets that take zero visible damage from the hit.

name: Zamorak godsword
description: Special attack 'Ice Cleave' freezes the target for 32 ticks on a successful hit rolled against slash defence. Protect from Melee only reduces the special's damage by 40% and does not prevent or shorten the freeze.

name: Soulreaper axe
description: Builds up to 5 hidden 'soul stacks' from landed hits, each granting +6% Strength (up to +30% at 5 stacks) not shown on the stats screen. Stacks decay one at a time after 30 seconds without landing a hit, and the hit that generates a stack doesn't itself benefit from it.

name: Noxious halberd
description: Carries an unlisted chance to envenom non-immune targets (33%, or 50% when a Serpentine helm is also worn), and deals full, non-reduced damage to the Corporeal Beast specifically when using the stab attack style.

name: Zaryte crossbow
description: Passively strengthens the special effects of enchanted bolts (e.g. ruby, diamond, onyx) by 10%, a bonus not reflected anywhere on the equipment stats screen.

name: Barronite mace
description: Carries an unlisted +15% accuracy and damage bonus against golem-type monsters.

name: Thammaron's sceptre
description: When charged with revenant ether and used in the Wilderness, grants an unlisted +50% Magic accuracy and damage bonus against NPCs, stacking with a Slayer helmet or Salve amulet (but not both at once).

name: Accursed sceptre
description: The upgraded Thammaron's sceptre: when charged with revenant ether and used in the Wilderness, grants the same unlisted +50% Magic accuracy and damage bonus against NPCs, stacking with a Slayer helmet or Salve amulet (but not both at once).

name: Viggora's chainmace
description: When charged with revenant ether and used in the Wilderness, grants an unlisted +50% melee accuracy and damage bonus against NPCs, consuming 1 ether per attack regardless of whether it hits; stacks with a Slayer helmet or Salve amulet (but not both at once).

name: Keris partisan of corruption
description: Retains the base keris's 33% damage bonus vs. Kalphite-type monsters. Its special attack 'Wrath of Amascut' (75% energy) doubles accuracy and adds 25% damage on the triggering hit, and applies a 25% increased damage-taken vulnerability to the target for 10 ticks - none of which is shown on the stats screen.

name: Keris partisan of breaching
description: Unlike the other jewelled keris variants, retains its 33% damage/accuracy bonus against Kalphite-type monsters (plus the chance to triple damage) outside of the Tombs of Amascut raid, making it usable as a general-purpose Kalphite weapon.

name: Silverlight
description: Grants an unlisted +60% bonus to both accuracy and max hit against demons.

name: Darklight
description: Grants the same unlisted +60% bonus to both accuracy and max hit against demons as Silverlight, its predecessor.

name: Leaf-bladed weapons (battleaxe, sword, spear)
description: Grants an unlisted +17.5% damage bonus specifically against turoths and kurasks, which stacks additively with a Slayer helmet's damage bonus.

name: Blisterwood flail
description: Grants an unlisted +25% damage and +5% accuracy bonus against vampyres of any tier, neither of which appears on the equipment stats screen.

name: Dawnbringer
description: Ignores accuracy rolls entirely on its normal attack, always landing a successful hit against Verzik's shield even at very low effective Magic attack - a mechanic invisible to the stats interface.

name: Blue moon spear
description: As part of the 'Frostweaver' set effect with full blue moon armour, successfully casting a Bind, Ice, or Grasp spell has a chance to trigger an instant bonus melee attack from the spear with no action-delay cost - a proc chain not shown on the item's stats.

name: Tonalztics of ralos
description: In charged 'rapid' (dual-throw) mode, each activation performs two fully independent accuracy and damage rolls against the target's light ranged defence in a single attack window, effectively doubling hit-chance opportunities beyond what the single set of displayed stats suggests.

name: Bryophyta's staff
description: While charged, gives a 1 in 15 chance to save a nature rune when casting a spell that requires one - a save chance not shown anywhere on the equipment stats interface.

name: Seercull
description: Special attack 'Soulshot' lowers the target's Magic level by an amount equal to the damage dealt, but only takes effect if their Magic isn't already reduced - repeated specs have no further effect until it regenerates.

name: Toxic blowpipe
description: Has an unlisted 1/3 chance per shot to not consume a scale (averaging 2 scales per 3 shots), separate from its displayed poison chance. Protect Item preserves remaining dart/scale charges on death.

name: Dragon dagger
description: The double-hit 'Puncture' special performs two independent accuracy rolls - each hit can land or miss separately, a behavior not stated in the spec tooltip.

name: Abyssal dagger
description: The double-hit 'Abyssal Puncture' special shares a single accuracy roll - both hits land together or both miss together, the opposite of the dragon dagger's independent-roll behavior.

name: Granite maul
description: 'Quick Smash' special attack carries no weapon attack-delay, letting a normal attack or another special follow immediately - a timing quirk the tooltip doesn't convey. Unlike most specials, it grants no accuracy bonus; the ornate handle variant reduces spec cost from 60% to 50%.

name: Wolfbane
description: As a silver weapon, carries a hidden +10% damage bonus against tier-1 vampyres not shown on its stats (otherwise identical to a mithril dagger).

name: Rod of ivandis
description: Silver weapon with a hidden +10% damage bonus against vampyres, and is able to damage tier-2 vampyres unlike ordinary weapons.

name: Ivandis flail
description: Upgraded Rod of ivandis; carries a hidden +20% damage bonus against tier 2-3 vampyres not reflected on the stats screen.

name: Blisterwood sickle
description: Hidden +15% damage and +5% accuracy bonus against vampyres, undocumented in the stats interface.

name: Blisterwood stake
description: Hidden +25% damage and +25% accuracy bonus against vampyres, not shown on the stats screen.

name: Hallowed flail
description: Hidden +25% damage and +25% accuracy bonus against vampyres of all tiers, not shown on stats.

name: Sunspear
description: Hidden +25% accuracy and +50% damage bonus against vampyres - the strongest vampyrebane bonus in the game, unlisted on the stats screen.

name: Purging staff
description: Beyond its base 10% magic damage bonus, doubles the accuracy bonus of demonbane spells cast through it (20% to 40%), further doubling to 80% accuracy / 50% damage while Mark of Darkness is active - none of this is shown on the item stats.

name: Slayer's staff (e)
description: While attacking your current Slayer assignment, silently boosts Magic Dart's max hit well beyond its normal formula (bolt turns white instead of green); reverts to ordinary damage against non-task monsters. Not indicated anywhere on the stats screen.

name: Twinflame staff
description: Casting a non-Strike/Surge elemental spell fires a free second hit at the same target one tick later, dealing 40% of the first hit's damage with no extra runes or XP cost - a mechanic not shown on the staff's stats.

name: Colossal blade
description: Grants a hidden max hit bonus of +2 per tile of the target's size (capped at +10 against size 5+ monsters), stacking with a Black mask/Slayer helmet - not reflected anywhere on the stats screen.

name: Ancient godsword
description: Special attack 'Blood Sacrifice' marks the target to flee 5+ tiles within 8 ticks or take 25 typeless damage (bypasses Protect from Magic, can stack to 50 total), healing the wielder up to 15% of the target's max HP - none of this is shown on the spec tooltip.

name: Dual macuahuitl
description: When worn with the full Blood moon armour set, successful hits have a 33% chance to attack one tick early (~55.5% cumulative given its two hits per attack) - the 'Bloodrager' set effect, not shown on the weapon's own stats.

name: Eclipse atlatl
description: When worn with the full Eclipse moon armour set, successful hits have a 20% chance to inflict a stacking burn (10 damage over 40 ticks, up to 5 stacks) - not shown on the weapon's own stats.

name: Burning claws
description: Hidden +5% accuracy and +5% damage against demons not shown on the stats screen. Special attack 'Burning Barrage' hits 3 times with escalating burn chance per landed hit (15%/30%/45%), each burn dealing 10 damage over 40 ticks, stacking up to 5.

name: Soulflame horn
description: Special attack 'Entice' guarantees the wielder's (and up to 3 nearby allies') next melee attack within 10 ticks will land (in PvP this becomes a +50% accuracy boost instead of a guarantee) - a support mechanic invisible from the weapon's stats.

name: Bow of Faerdhinen / Crystal bow
description: Damage and accuracy are silently boosted by up to +15%/+30% when the full Crystal armour set is also worn, a bonus not reflected on the bow's own displayed stats.
